author: Spread
name: Vital ring
description: A ring with a glowing knob at the value, the number inside and a unit (the label) below it — heart rate, breaths, any vital sign.
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 120 120"><style>.cap{font-family:'SF Pro Display',Inter,'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;fill:currentColor;opacity:.7}.num{font-family:'SF Pro Display',Inter,'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:200;fill:currentColor;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.trk{fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.12}.val{fill:none;stroke:url(#vg);stroke-width:5;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-dasharray:100;stroke-dashoffset:calc((1 - var(--v)) * 100);transform:rotate(-90deg);transform-origin:60px 60px}.kn{transform-origin:60px 60px;transform:rotate(calc(var(--v) * 360deg))}.big{font-size:30px}.u{font-family:'SF Pro Display',Inter,'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.1em;fill:currentColor;opacity:.75}</style><defs><linearGradient id="vg" x1="0" x2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#1f6bff"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#55b6ff"/></linearGradient><filter id="vb" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="2.5"/></filter></defs>
<circle class="trk" cx="60" cy="60" r="46" stroke-width="5"/><circle class="val" cx="60" cy="60" r="46" pathLength="100"/>
<g class="kn"><circle cx="60" cy="14" r="6" fill="#55b6ff" filter="url(#vb)"/><circle cx="60" cy="14" r="4" fill="#0b1630" stroke="#55b6ff" stroke-width="2"/></g>
<text x="60" y="64" text-anchor="middle" class="num big">{{value}}</text><text x="60" y="80" text-anchor="middle" class="u">{{label}}</text></svg>
